notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a successful RTIambassador::getAvailableDimensionsForObjectClass invocation reported through the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation interaction. The report content maps directly to IEEE 1516.1-2025 sections 11.5 and 11.5.1; federation setup reuses the existing federation execution API contract. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM (including the typed object class and its configured dimension), standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies the API's one-dimension result set, service classification, typed object-class-handle and dimension-set arguments, reliable report delivery, reporter identity, success/exception state, and report serial. Provider-private headers, registries, routing, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
